title: 2067. Exchanging the Values of Two Variables

Exchanging the Values of Two Variables
10
Easy
Problem Statement
Read two integers and exchange (swap) their values using a third variable, then print the swapped values.
Description
Read two integers a and b from input. Exchange the values of a and b using a temporary (third) variable, then print the new value of a followed by the new value of b. This uses only variables, assignment statements, and printf/scanf — no loops or conditions are needed.
Input Description
Two integers a and b separated by a space.
Output Description
Print the swapped value of a, then the swapped value of b, each on its own line.
Sample Input
5 10
Sample Output
10
